scenarios.title: exit 0
scenarios.command: mkdir -p .beacon/qa-tmp && beacon doctor verify-truth-integrity beacon-harness-program-plan-v161 --project-root . --version v1.6.1 --mode block --json >.beacon/qa-tmp/TC-PBP-008.json && python3 -c "import json; d=json.load(open('.beacon/qa-tmp/TC-PBP-008.json')); raise SystemExit(0 if d.get('result',{}).get('blocked') is False else 1)"

scenarios.title: closure_allowed=true
